//: Composite indexes. Firestore auto-creates single-field indexes, but a query with an equality filter on one field and an orderBy on a DIFFERENT field needs a composite one declared here. Without it the query fails on the server with FAILED_PRECONDITION — and because listeners serve the local cache first, the symptom is data appearing for a moment and then vanishing. That is exactly what happened to received private replies. Deploy with: npm run deploy:indexes
